headline: Bring ecobee comfort controls into Home Assistant
intro: Connect your ecobee account to control thermostat modes, target temperatures, and comfort settings, while bringing thermostat sensor readings into Home Assistant. Since Home Assistant 2026.3, setup uses your ecobee username and password without requiring a newly registered developer API key; an existing key can still be used.
highlights: Sign in with ecobee account credentials, with authenticator-app or SMS MFA when enabled
View thermostat sensor data and control climate modes, targets, and holds
Use supported ventilator and auxiliary-heat controls, and send notifications to a thermostat

flow.title: From ecobee account to home controls
stages: Submit an MFA code if prompted
